title: Best Tracker Ever
body:
I think this might be my first ever review on an app but this is too good to be quiet. I’m a Premium user, have been for the past 5-ish years. It’s so simple and uncluttered. I can compare the trend of my habits over days, months, years.

I can see my streaks with habits. There’s this tiny feature where if you tap on the current day/yesterday, you can track habits in rapid succession without having to tap the row below. It may be a small thing but it really makes the user experience loads better.

You can categorise habits, add notes to each track, and set reminders (I haven’t used this last feature a lot though)

But yeah, if you’re thinking of a habit tracker, just pay for this. It’s worth it!
author: beaver_weaver_pier
